R01.criterion: Accepting a nonempty green rollup can exit before queued/running Actions jobs register. Require evidence about exact-head runs and handle incomplete data.

R02.criterion: Reject a manual duplicate archive entry solely to make HQ see the note. A clearly optional docs note may still be low-value here, and no behavior changes are needed for generated discovery.

R03.criterion: Reject requests for new preservation/state or a test that attempts a concurrent title edit through the disabled editor. An independent supported entry path or distinct stale-calorie defect would need its own evidence.

R04.criterion: A fresh scoped hold is hidden when phase is absent. Render/reconcile independent observations and cover a hold-only state.

R05.criterion: Reject using any permission denial as a delivery failure signal or new required alert. The supplied healthy run had denials. Optional telemetry with an independent rationale is outside the target.

R06.criterion: The generic date check rejects legitimate offering evidence when publication precedes effectiveness. Tie allowance to the source-bound offering and preserve the as-of-date guard.

R07.criterion: A pending SDK write outlives cancel, while relaunch can offer stale Discard because saving is not persisted before enqueue. Suppress discard or prevent queuing and test relaunch/reconnect.

R08.criterion: Reject claims that older cancelled duplicates block once the newest exact-head job succeeded. Out-of-sample monitoring or distinct evidence is outside this target.

R09.criterion: Find stale 48g integration assertion under the changed formatter and the release gate. Change the assertion and retain linked-nutrition and Undo behavior.

R10.criterion: Reject promoting a diagnostic to any non-planned state without the run required by the reader. A useful finding separately asks for owned tracking of pending upload.

R11.criterion: An absent tracking ref can resolve to a tag whose name is the full tracking path, reading untrusted policy. Use exact ref lookup and cover absent ref plus colliding tag.

R12.criterion: Reject aliases/duplicate declarations just to satisfy validation of recognized constants. Preserve one declaration owner.
